data.description: Countless souls have been lured along the Grand Line in pursuit of the legendary One Piece! Monkey D. Luffy is a young pirate with a dream: to prove the legend true and be king of them all!
data.title: I'm Luffy! The Man Who's Gonna Be King of the Pirates!

data.description: Luffy and his new companion Coby set sail in search of the infamous pirate hunter Zoro, rumored to be held captive at the Marine Base.

data.title: Morgan versus Luffy! Who's the Mysterious Pretty Girl?
data.next_episode_title: Luffy's Past! Enter Red-Haired Shanks!
data.description: Luffy is in the line of fire after saving Zoro, and now tyrannical Captain Morgan is out for their heads! Zoro must decide if he will join forces with Luffy or die in captivity.
Luffy recalls a time when Captain Red-Haired Shanks taught him a valuable lesson in friendship and set him on his quest to be King of the Pirates.
data.title: Luffy's Past! Enter Red-Haired Shanks!
data.next_episode_title: A Terrifying Mysterious Power! Captain Buggy, the Clown Pirate!

data.description: Luffy crosses paths with the clever thief Nami. A navigator on a quest to collect one hundred million berries, she's perfect for Luffy's new crew – except for the fact that Nami hates pirates.

data.title: A Terrifying Mysterious Power! Captain Buggy, the Clown Pirate!
Desperate Situation! Beast Tamer Mohji Vs. Luffy!
data.description: Having delivered a deadly blow to Captain Buggy's pirates, Luffy and his companions need a place to recuperate. But the three are not in hiding very long before the Beast Tamer Mohji seeks them out.
data.next_episode_title: Epic Showdown! Swordsman Zoro Vs. Acrobat Cabaji!

data.title: Epic Showdown! Swordsman Zoro Vs. Acrobat Cabaji!
data.description: In the ongoing fight with Captain Buggy's pirates, Zoro must face off with the Acrobat Cabaji while Luffy continues to do battle with the Pirate Clown himself.
data.next_episode_title: Who Is the Victor? Devil Fruit Power Showdown!
The Honorable Liar? Captain Usopp!
data.description: Luffy and the gang are on the run after the battle with Captain Buggy! With no place to go and nothing else to do, Nami finally agrees to join Luffy on his quest.
data.title: Who Is the Victor? Devil Fruit Power Showdown!
The Honorable Liar? Captain Usopp!
data.next_episode_title: The Weirdest Guy Ever! Jango the Hypnotist!
data.description: Luffy, Zoro, and Nami arrive at an island hoping to obtain a ship and crew, but the three are quickly confronted with the blustering Captain Usopp - who has a connection to Luffy's past.

data.next_episode_title: Expose the Plot! Pirate Butler, Captain Kuro!
data.title: The Weirdest Guy Ever! Jango the Hypnotist!
data.description: Luffy follows Usopp to the mansion and encounters the brutal pirate Captain Kuro. The scoundrel plans to claim Kaya's fortune and live the stolen life of luxury.

data.next_episode_title: Clash With the Black Cat Pirates! the Great Battle On the Slope!
data.title: Expose the Plot! Pirate Butler, Captain Kuro!
data.description: Usopp spreads word of Kuro's evil plot and the impending pirate attack, but no one believes his warnings. The Straw Hat Pirates decide to help Usopp put a stop to the dastardly scheme.

data.next_episode_title: The Terrifying Duo! Meowban Brothers Vs. Zoro!
data.title: Clash With the Black Cat Pirates! the Great Battle On the Slope!
data.description: Luffy and crew seek to best Captain Kuro, but they've prepared their defense on the wrong side of the island! All looks grim now that Usopp must face off against the Black Cat Pirates alone.

data.next_episode_title: Luffy Back in Action! Miss Kaya's Desperate Resistance!
data.title: The Terrifying Duo! Meowban Brothers Vs. Zoro!
data.description: In an effort to save Usopp's village, the Straw Hat Pirates seek to block the marauders' path from the sea. With Luffy out of the battle, Zoro must face the fearsome Meowban Brothers!

data.title: Luffy Back in Action! Miss Kaya's Desperate Resistance!
data.next_episode_title: Beat Kuro! Usopp the Man's Tearful Resolve!
data.description: Nami manages to rescue Zoro's missing swords and attempts to revive Luffy. With one of the Meowban brothers down, the other rages on even more fiercely than before!
Usopp's friends run away with the heiress Kaya. Jango races off after them, but not before sending Butchie into a berserk rage. As Zoro continues his battle, Luffy takes on Captain Kuro.
data.next_episode_title: Protect Kaya! The Usopp Pirates' Great Efforts!
data.title: Beat Kuro! Usopp the Man's Tearful Resolve!
Protect Kaya! The Usopp Pirates' Great Efforts!
data.description: Luffy battles with Kuro on the beach, while the Veggies (with Kaya in tow) flee Jango the Hypnotist.
data.next_episode_title: Anger Explosion! Kuro Vs. Luffy! How It Ends!

data.title: Anger Explosion! Kuro Vs. Luffy! How It Ends!
data.description: Kaya rewards the Straw Hat Pirates' efforts to save her with a ship to call their own - the Going Merry!
data.next_episode_title: You're the Weird Creature! Gaimon and His Strange Friends!

data.title: You're the Weird Creature! Gaimon and His Strange Friends!
data.description: On the legendary Treasure Island, Luffy and crew encounter strange animals and an even stranger man named Gaimon.
data.next_episode_title: The Three-Sword Style's Past! Zoro and Kuina's Vow!

data.description: In the past, young Zoro sparred constantly with a girl named Kuina, but he could never claim victory. They vowed that one of them would someday be the world's greatest swordsman - but tragedy intervened.
data.next_episode_title: Famous Cook! Sanji of the Sea Restaurant!

Famous Cook! Sanji of the Sea Restaurant!
data.description: The Straw Hats need a cook among their crew, so they head to a nearby restaurant and meet a passionate Sous Chef named Sanji.
data.next_episode_title: Unwelcome Customer! Sanji's Food and Ghin's Debt!
The Strongest Pirate Fleet! Commodore Don Krieg!
data.title: Unwelcome Customer! Sanji's Food and Ghin's Debt!
data.description: Luffy witnesses the fighting prowess and compassionate nature of the Sous Chef Sanji. The good news: The Going Merry's found a cook! The bad news: He has no intention of joining the crew!
The staff and patrons of the Baratie panic when Don Krieg arrives! The starving pirate begs for nourishment, only to find himself denied. Unable to see a wretch starve, Sanji steps in once again.
data.next_episode_title: Protect Baratie! the Great Pirate, Red Foot Zeff!
data.title: The Strongest Pirate Fleet! Commodore Don Krieg!

data.description: Don Krieg promises further malice as he returns to his ship, but the threat to the Baratie proves short-lived as an even bigger threat arrives!
data.title: Protect Baratie! the Great Pirate, Red Foot Zeff!
Hawk-Eye Mihawk! the Great Swordsman Zoro Falls at Sea!
data.description: The Going Merry's been stolen by Nami, and the showdown for possession of the Baratie is delayed. But the action's not dead in the water - Zoro challenges Hawk-Eye Mihawk to a duel!
data.next_episode_title: The Deadly Foot Technique Bursts Forth! Sanji Vs. the Invincible Pearl!

data.description: The battle begins for possession of the Baratie, with Zeff leading the cooks against Krieg's pirates. Luffy and crew join the fray, but things aren't looking too good!
data.title: The Deadly Foot Technique Bursts Forth! Sanji Vs. the Invincible Pearl!

data.title: Zeff and Sanji's Dream! the Illusory All Blue!
data.description: Sanji recalls his childhood as an apprentice chef aboard a ship attacked by Red Foot Zeff! When the young Sanji found himself overboard, it was the fearsome captain himself who jumped to the rescue.

data.title: Cool-headed, Cold-hearted Demon! Pirate Fleet Chief Commander Ghin!
data.description: As the battle for Baratie rages on, Luffy is forced to take a drastic course of action and Ghin debates where his loyalties lie.

data.title: I Won't Die! Fierce Battle, Luffy Vs. Krieg!
data.description: The scoundrel Don Krieg appears to have the upper hand in his fight with Luffy. To avoid walking the plank, the rubber man must try a different strategy.
The standoff between Luffy and Don Krieg takes a turn in favor of the Straw Hats when their captain focuses his onslaught on his opponent's weaponry.

data.title: The Conclusion of the Deadly Battle! a Spear of Blind Determination!

data.description: With Don Krieg defeated, Luffy tries to convince Sanji to join up with the Straw Hats. The skilled cook is interested, but he has something to prove before moving on.

Zoro is captured by Fishman Arlong and learns a shocking secret about Nami. Unable to believe his ears, he puts the navigator to the ultimate test.

data.description: Luffy and his crew make their way towards Arlong Park and a showdown with its fishy proprietor. Along the way, they discover a treasure map that raises more questions about Nami.

Untold Past! Female Warrior Bellemere!
data.description: A fierce argument over where Nami's loyalties lie divides the Straw Hat Pirates and only one thing's for sure - no one is willing to risk their life for a traitor.

data.description: Nami's adopted sister, Nojiko arrives to fill in some details about the skilled mapmaker's younger days.
data.title: Untold Past! Female Warrior Bellemere!

Luffy Rises! Result of the Broken Promise!

data.description: Nezumi comes to confiscate Nami's treasure, but who's he working for? More importantly, who's Nami working for, and what's she gonna do with her booty?

data.description: The Straw Hats' faith in Nami is restored, and now it's time for a battle royal! Luffy and the gang are determined to make Arlong pay for mistreating their friend.

data.description: The Straw Hats and Arlong's fishmen are locked in a swashbuckling slugfest, but things take a bad turn when Luffy gets trapped beneath the waves.

data.description: While his friends work to free the captain of the Straw Hats, cowardly Usopp finds himself in a position to shed his yellow streak and make his father proud.

data.title: Luffy at Full Power! Nami's Determination and the Straw Hat!
data.description: Nami must decide between letting Arlong maintain his hold over her, or joining the Straw Hats and leading the oppressed villagers against the tyrant fishman.

data.title: Explosion! Fishman Arlong's Fierce Assault from the Sea!
data.description: Arlong better watch his back-fins, because Captain Luffy knows about all the horrible things he did to Nami - and it makes his blood boil?

data.description: Something about Nami's former prison gives Luffy an added burst of strength. He's so moved by her terrible past that he vows to destroy all of Arlong Park!

data.description: After a grueling fight, Luffy defeats Arlong and succeeds in destroying his headquarters. The merry marauders enjoy the fruits of victory while Nami makes peace with her turbulent past.

data.title: Bounty! Straw Hat Luffy Becomes Known to the World!
data.description: Finally, the day has arrived where Luffy's face is on an authentic wanted poster! Now there are enemies in hot pursuit as the crew makes waves for Logue Town - final resting place of Gold Roger!
Buggy gets marooned on an island inhabited by unusual creatures and tangles with the island's caretaker, Gaimon. If he is to finally destroy Luffy, Buggy must cast his lot with a mysterious woman.

data.description: The Buggy Pirates fight each other for the right to take their lost captain's place. While they're busy beating each other's brains out, a cannibalistic tribe makes plans to have something special for dinner.

data.description: Luffy has a run-in with Captain Smoker, and his failure to keep a low profile helps Buggy draw a bead on him. Elsewhere, Zoro takes a chance that his skill can overcome a dangerous curse.

Usopp finds an amazing pair of sharpshooter's goggles, but they lead to a run in with Daddy the Parent - the greatest gunslinger ever! Now, the Straw Hat marksman is headed for the deadliest of all duels.
